nodes.description: Initializes MAX_FUEGO supply cap and computes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from saleStart; sets deployer as owner via Ownable.
onlyOwner function that splits the contract ETH balance across five hardcoded addresses by percentage using low-level send().

Public function that derives the pseudo-random startingIndex from blockhash/startingIndexBlock; callable by anyone.
onlyOwner escape hatch that forces startingIndexBlock = block.number when reveal indexing stalled.
Internal mint wrapper that mints the token and then performs the ERC721 receiver check.
Internal mint that assigns ownership and emits Transfer.
